verses.english: This was said by the Buddha, the Perfected One: that is what I heard.

verses.pali: “Tathāgatassa, bhikkhave, arahato sammāsambuddhassa dve dhammadesanā pariyāyena bhavanti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, the Realized One, the perfected one, the fully awakened Buddha has two approaches to teaching Dhamma.
this is the first approach to teaching Dhamma.

verses.pali: ‘pāpaṁ pāpakato disvā tattha nibbindatha virajjatha vimuccathā’ti—
verses.english: ‘Having seen evil as evil, be disillusioned, dispassionate, and freed from it’—
this is the second approach to teaching Dhamma.

verses.pali: Tathāgatassa, bhikkhave, arahato sammāsambuddhassa imā dve dhammadesanā pariyāyena bhavantī”ti.
verses.english: The Realized One, the perfected one, the fully awakened Buddha has these two approaches to teaching Dhamma.”
used by the Realized One, the Buddha,
Then, with a mind free of desire,
you will make an end of suffering.”

verses.pali: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
verses.english: This too is a matter that was spoken by the Blessed One: that is what I heard.
